notes.title: New tanks and game mode! Patch notes v1.03g
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys![/b]

This Battle Bolts update comes with a brand new game mode called "Racing", as well as 2 brand new tanks, the long anticipated return to lobby option and some balance changes!
We plan to keep improving the racing game mode based on the community feedback, as well as general game balance. All feedback is welcome!

[h1]Two new tanks! [/h1]
[b]Medusa Tank[/b]
-Front weapon ability “Split Shot” On impact deals 3 damage and splits into 2 cannonballs each dealing 1 damage on impact
-Side weapon ability “Bounce Grenade” Grenade that bounces 2 additional times with diminished effects

[b]Ranger tank[/b]
-Front weapon ability “Heavy Cannon Ball“ Deals 3 damage and knocks targets back 1 tile
-Side weapon ability “Nuke” Grenade with massive explosion radius

[h1]Balance changes
[/h1]
[b]Banshee[/b]
-Front special damage reduced from 4 to 3, pull is still present
-Side special will now try to pull diagonal targets to middle tile.Middle tile damage reduced from 4 to 2. Does not explode above open pits

[b]Volt
[/b]-Front special now deals 3 damage to initial and any chained targets. Chain radius is still 2 tiles around impact.

[b]Bullseye[/b]
-Front special now deals 3 damage to all pierced targets

[h1]AI Improvements
[/h1]-Less Predicatable 
-Decreased difficulty
-Dash is now reliably executed and incorporated into overall strategy


[h1]New Race Mode 
[/h1]-Players can now race in this new fun mode. Goal is to end turn on a tile highlighted in player color. All other mechanics apply
-Added 3 race arenas (SHIFTY LANES, CROSSROADS and DRIVE-THRU)

[h1]Game improvements [/h1]
-Improvements to network stability and bug fixes
-Players will now see each other’s usernames when in the same lobby
-Players return to lobby after match has ended

notes.title: Battle Bolts out of Early Access - and Fight Night Events!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, soldiers![/h1]

We are pleased to announce that [b]Battle Bolts is out of Early Access[/b]! 

This version of the game comes with all sorts of upgrades to the pre-EA game, including a [b]shinier HUD, lots more maps to play on and most importantly, an online multiplayer mode[/b] where you can play with (and against) real friends (and foes!) from all over the world!

Since the game is best enjoyed in multiplayer against real opponents, we are going to host a [b]series of online community events[/b] - and you are invited to come along! Our first event will be [b]happening today[/b]: [i]May 25th, 2019 at 5:00 PM / 17:00 UTC[/i].

The events will take place in [b]Croteam's official Discord server[/b]. Be sure you [url=https://discord.gg/croteam]join the server[/url], and stay to chill with us and other players! 
After all, there is no better place to bond with your fellow comrades than the battlefield!

[b]To stay notified about more Battle Bolts news and events, make sure you follow our social media pages!

[url=https://twitter.com/BattleBolts]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/battlebolts/]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/Croteam]Croteam Twitter[/url]
